agent: an Australian pilot (David John Cutmore, pleaded guilty; named in the PNG court record and Pacific press)
object: the cabin/cargo door of a crashed light twin, nose-down at a tree line, pulled open on an empty cabin
place: a bush airstrip at Papa Lea Lea, outside Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea
gotcha: It never cleared the trees. Police found the wreck empty, the pilot gone.
person_line: Two days later he walked into Australia's consulate and gave himself up. David Cutmore had reportedly been promised a million dollars.
consequence_line: He pleaded guilty. Eighteen years, in a Papua New Guinea jail. His appeal failed.
